keyword.title: Keyword (optional)
keyword.description: Free-text search across the filings, e.g. a company name or a word like "software" or "clinic". Leave blank for every new Form D filing.

states.title: States (optional)
states.description: Two-letter state codes of the company's business address, e.g. "CA", "NY". Leave empty for nationwide.

industries.title: Industries (optional)
industries.description: Keep filings whose Form D industry contains any of these, e.g. "Technology", "Health Care", "Biotechnology", "Real Estate", "Restaurants", "Banking". Leave empty for all.

minAmountSold.title: Minimum amount raised, USD (optional)
minAmountSold.description: Keep filings that report at least this much sold so far, e.g. 1000000.

includeFunds.title: Include investment funds
includeFunds.description: Pooled investment funds (hedge, private equity, real estate funds and SPVs) are about half of all Form D filings. They're left out unless you turn this on.

includeAmendments.title: Include amendments
includeAmendments.description: Form D/A amends an earlier filing rather than announcing a new raise. Left out unless you turn this on.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to include, by filing date (1 to 90).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum filings to return, newest first (1 to 500). Each filing is read in full, about 4 a second.

onlyNew.title: Only filings not returned before
onlyNew.description: For scheduled runs: skip filings that earlier runs with the same list name already returned.

seenListName.title: Already-returned list name
seenListName.description: The list onlyNew remembers filings in. Give each schedule or client its own name.
